groups.directions:
Topic: Reading Comprehension
Subtopic: Factual RC

Passage 1 (Questions 1-5):
The global push for renewable energy has accelerated over the past decade. In 2022, wind and solar generated a record 12% of global electricity, up from 10% in 2021. Despite this growth, fossil fuels still dominate the energy matrix. Coal remains the single largest source of electricity globally, accounting for 36% of production in 2022. The International Energy Agency (IEA) report highlights that while Europe and China are leading in the deployment of renewable infrastructure, developing nations in Africa face severe financial bottlenecks. A staggering $1.5 trillion annual investment is needed by 2030 in emerging economies to meet the net-zero emission targets. Meanwhile, natural gas saw a slight decline of 0.5% in global usage due to geopolitical tensions disrupting supply chains in Eastern Europe.

questions.text: According to the passage, what percentage of global electricity was generated by wind and solar in 2022?
questions.explanation: The passage explicitly states, "In 2022, wind and solar generated a record 12% of global electricity."

questions.text: Which energy source is mentioned as the single largest contributor to global electricity production in 2022?
questions.explanation: The text states, "Coal remains the single largest source of electricity globally, accounting for 36% of production in 2022."

questions.text: What is the annual investment required by 2030 in emerging economies to meet net-zero emission targets?
questions.explanation: The passage mentions, "A staggering $1.5 trillion annual investment is needed by 2030 in emerging economies..."

questions.text: According to the passage, which regions are leading the deployment of renewable infrastructure?
questions.explanation: The passage explicitly mentions that "Europe and China are leading in the deployment of renewable infrastructure."

questions.text: Why did natural gas usage see a slight decline globally?

options.label: D
options.text: The rapid rise of wind and solar

questions.explanation: The passage states, "natural gas saw a slight decline of 0.5% in global usage due to geopolitical tensions disrupting supply chains in Eastern Europe."

questions.text: Where did the 2023 expedition take place?
questions.explanation: The passage states, "In a 2023 expedition to the Mariana Trench..."

questions.text: What was the average concentration of microplastic particles found in the sediment?
questions.explanation: The text specifies, "an average of 45 microplastic particles per liter of sediment."

questions.text: Which types of plastic are predominantly found in the Mariana Trench sediment?
questions.explanation: The passage explicitly notes, "These particles predominantly consist of polyethylene terephthalate (PET) and nylon."

questions.text: What are "ghost nets" as referred to in the passage?

questions.text: How do microplastics physically harm deep-sea amphipods?

options.label: C
options.text: By causing intestinal blockages and a false sense of satiation

options.label: D
options.text: By making them more visible to predators

questions.explanation: The passage explains that ingesting plastics "can lead to intestinal blockages and a false sense of satiation, ultimately causing starvation."

questions.text: Who is credited with inventing the printing press in Europe?
questions.explanation: The passage states, "Invented by Johannes Gutenberg in Mainz, Germany, around 1440..."

questions.text: What was the title of Gutenberg's first major publication?
questions.explanation: The passage identifies, "Gutenberg's first major publication was the 'Forty-Two-Line Bible' in 1455."

questions.text: How many volumes had been produced by printing presses in Western Europe by the year 1500?
questions.explanation: The text states that by 1500, printing presses "had already produced more than twenty million volumes."

questions.text: What term is used in the passage to describe the era of early printing up to the year 1500?
questions.explanation: The passage refers to "This era, known as the incunabula period..."

questions.text: Which three metals were mixed to create the alloy for Gutenberg's typepieces?
questions.explanation: The passage explicitly states the alloy was "a mix of lead, tin, and antimony."
